Medjool dates, oats, peanut butter, cocoa and honey blitzed into chewy balls, rolled in toasted coconut with a pinch of sea salt. Pit 12 medjool dates and blitz with 100g rolled oats, 120g peanut butter, 2 tbsp cocoa, 1 tbsp honey and a pinch of sea salt until it clumps. Roll into 16 balls. Toast 50g desiccated coconut in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden, cool and roll the balls in it. Chill 30 minutes before serving.
M: Seared scotch fillet with a sunny side up egg, hash browns and grilled tomato, casino breakfast at any hour.

Beef chuck browned hard and braised slowly with onion, carrot, celery, tomato and thyme, potatoes in for the last hour, with crusty bread. Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches in 2 tbsp oil. Soften a diced onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks in the same pot. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, thyme and 750ml beef stock, cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Add 600g chunked potatoes and braise 1 hour more until tender. Serve with crusty bread.
W: Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour folded in, baked at 170C for 40 minutes, covered in fudge frosting, a red fondant ball sitting on top.
K: water breaks between rounds at Average Joe's

Fresh orange and lemon juice stirred with honey and a pinch of salt, topped with soda over ice with orange wheels and mint. Stir 500ml fresh orange juice with the juice of 2 lemons, 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of fine salt until the honey dissolves. Fill four tall glasses with ice and orange wheels, pour in the juice and top each with 100ml soda water. Finish with mint.

s.note: dodge, duck, dip, dive and dodge
s.how: Cut 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks, 1 cucumber and 1 red capsicum into sticks. Serve with 200g hummus, 200g tzatziki and a quick dip of 200ml sour cream stirred with 1 tbsp sweet chilli sauce, plus crackers for anyone who skips the vegetables.

s.note: round, red and ready to throw
s.how: Mix 250g beef mince and 250g pork mince with 40g parmesan, chopped parsley and a crushed garlic clove. Roll into 24 balls and brown. Simmer in a tin of crushed tomatoes for 30 minutes. Serve on toothpicks.

m.how: Season 4 scotch fillet steaks and sear in a hot pan for 3 to 4 minutes a side, then rest. Bake 8 frozen hash browns until crisp and grill 4 halved tomatoes. Fry 4 eggs sunny side up in 20g butter and serve one on top of each steak.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter. Whisk in 4 eggs and 200g sugar, then fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake at 170C for 40 minutes. Cover with fudge frosting of 300g icing sugar, 40g cocoa and 80g butter, and top with a red fondant ball.
